findings.claim: CommandEventBridge's floor.updateLayers case emits `floor.layer-updated` under the comment 'so FragmentBuilder subscribers know the floor's system-type / layer stack has changed and can trigger a mesh rebuild'. findings.claim: floor.create with no polygon passes canExecute (which only rejects a polygon that is PRESENT and short) and commits a floor whose boundary.polygon is []. The SS-P3.2-FL bridge then returns early on `!ev.polygon || ev.polygon.length < 3`, so the record exists in the plugin store and in no renderer, no plan view, no legacy store and no save file. Compounding it: an L0 `Floor` schema EXISTS at packages/schemas/src/elements/Floor.ts and CreateFloorHandler does not use it -- it hand-builds the record and casts `as unknown as FloorData`, so the schema's own guards never run. roof/column/beam all call their L0 parser; floor is the odd one out, and it is also the only one of the four with no errors.ts and therefore no typed DomainError.
